articles.title: White Sox 7, Astros 3: How Chicago ended Houston's season with AL wild-card sweep
articles.description: The Astros look to stave off playoff elimination in Game 2 of the AL wild-card series. We'll have updates and analysis from Daikin Park throughout the day.

articles.title: 5 key moments from Houston Astros' Game 2 loss to Chicago White Sox in AL wild-card series
articles.description: A closer look at five key moments from Game 2 as the White Sox ended the Astros' season with a wild-card round sweep.

articles.title: Astros' Joe Espada acknowledges boos from Houston crowd in playoffs but adds 'I love our fans'
articles.description: Some Houston Astros fans booed the home team during Tuesday's Game 1 loss. Before Game 2, Joe Espada talked to his team about it, then publicly said how much he loves Houston fans.

articles.title: Daulton Varsho won't return to Houston Astros this season after undergoing wrist surgery
articles.description: The Astros' lone trade-deadline acquisition struggled at the plate after arriving from Toronto and won't return for any playoff action if the team advances.

articles.title: Astros say they're 'built for it' facing another must-win situation after Game 1 loss to White Sox
articles.description: The Astros, who found a way to push their way into the postseason, must now find a way to win consecutive games while facing playoff elimination. They're far from deterred.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV sends blessings to Chicago White Sox before Game 1 of wild-card series against Astros
articles.description: The Astros have the “Rally Nuns,” but the White Sox have Pope Leo XIV, who sent the team a letter invoking “the Almighty’s abundant blessings” upon them them for the playoffs.

articles.title: 'Something deceptive': How Astros' bats were held in check by a variety of White Sox arms in Game 1
articles.description: From Hagen Smith's low release point to Grant Taylor's high arm slot, the White Sox kept changing looks and Houston struggled to adjust as the Astros were pushed to the brink of elimination.

articles.title: White Sox explain why they asked for replay on Astros' Jose Altuve's positioning in Game 1 win
articles.description: White Sox manager Will Venable credited his video team with checking on where Jose Altuve was standing during Game 1 of the wild-card series and thought they had caught him out of position.

articles.title: It's about time: After long wait, Geoff Blum finally gets to call Houston Astros playoff games
articles.description: Geoff Blum, relegated to a spectator rule during previous postseasons, got to call his first Astros playoff game in Tuesday's opener against the White Sox.

articles.title: White Sox 6, Astros 3: How Chicago took the opening game in wild-card series
articles.description: The Astros and White Sox begin their best-of-3 series this afternoon. We'll have updates and analysis throughout the day from Daikin Park.

articles.title: Houston Astros to open with AJ Blubaugh in Game 1 against White Sox in wild-card series
articles.description: AJ Blubaugh led the majors with 96 innings of relief work this season and will be first man up in a 'bullpen' game to open wild-card series.

articles.title: Isaac Paredes could be the Houston Astros' most important hitter vs. Chicago White Sox. Here's why
articles.description: Batting behind Yordan Alvarez puts Isaac Paredes in a position to make teams pause before giving Alvarez an intentional walk.
